content: Fed interest rate pause consensus at 5.25%-5.50% sustains tech multiple expansion. High correlation between global liquidity index and AI capex commitments. Treasury yields stabilizing below 4.15% supports long-duration semiconductor valuations.

Institutional order flow shows heavy net call buying in Oct/Nov 140-150 strike contracts. Dark pool accumulation index printed 68.4 (90th percentile). Whale wallet flows indicate continuous rebalancing into hyperscaler proxy baskets.

Major cloud titans (MSFT, GOOGL, META) reiterate minimum 45% YoY increase in AI datacenter capex for FY27. Supply chain checks in Taiwan confirm GB200 rack production ramp progressing ahead of schedule with yield improvements.

Retail sentiment index at 74/100 (Greed). Social volume spikes 42% week-on-week. Options open interest put/call ratio falls to 0.58, indicating broad crowd complacency but persistent momentum chasing.

Price holding above the 20-day EMA ($128.50) and ascending channel boundary. Daily RSI at 64.2 showing healthy consolidation without overbought exhaustion. Volume expansion on up-days confirms structural bull trend with resistance at $142.
